
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/huazhixu/p/19077306" title="发布于 2025-09-06 20:12">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">PostgreSQL三种关闭方式的区别</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><strong>1、使用smart参数关闭数据库:</strong><br>smart：最为安全，但最慢，需要将所有连接都断开后，才会关库，默认关库模式。<br>smart: 等所有的连接中止后，关闭数据库。如果客户端连接不终止， 则无法关闭数据库。<br>[postgresql@master ~]$ pg_ctl stop -D $PGDATA -m smart<br>waiting for server to shut down.... done<br>server stopped<br>[postgresql@master ~]$<br><br><strong>使用smart参数关闭数据库的日志：</strong><br>2025-09-06 19:40:20.479 CST [56233] LOG:&nbsp; received smart shutdown request<br>2025-09-06 19:40:20.480 CST [56233] LOG:&nbsp; background worker "logical replication launcher" (PID 56241) exited with exit code 1<br>2025-09-06 19:40:20.480 CST [56236] LOG:&nbsp; shutting down<br>2025-09-06 19:40:20.485 CST [56233] LOG:&nbsp; database system is shut down<br><br><strong>2、使用fast参数关闭数据库:</strong><br>fast：强制中断会话，而不管有操作有没有提交，在做系统维护（系统维护时一般应用都正常关闭了，或者不再会有事务操作。）时，需要这种模式来关闭数据库。<br>fast: 快速关闭数据库， 断开客户端的连接，让已有的事务回滚，然后正常关闭数据库。<br>[postgresql@master ~]$ pg_ctl stop -D $PGDATA -m fast<br>waiting for server to shut down.... done<br>server stopped<br>[postgresql@master ~]<br><br><strong>使用fast参数关闭数据库的日志：</strong><br>2025-09-06 19:40:59.477 CST [56258] LOG:&nbsp; received fast shutdown request<br>2025-09-06 19:40:59.478 CST [56258] LOG:&nbsp; aborting any active transactions<br>2025-09-06 19:40:59.478 CST [56258] LOG:&nbsp; background worker "logical replication launcher" (PID 56266) exited with exit code 1<br>2025-09-06 19:40:59.479 CST [56261] LOG:&nbsp; shutting down<br>2025-09-06 19:40:59.484 CST [56258] LOG:&nbsp; database system is shut down<br><br><strong>3、使用immediate参数关闭数据库:</strong><br>immediate：最暴力的方式，不管数据有没有落盘（POSGRE是遵循WAL机制），就直接关掉，待启动时进行实例恢复，如果在关库前有大量的事务没有写入磁盘，那这个恢复过程可能会非常的漫长。<br>immediate: 立即关闭数据库，立即停止数据库进程，直接退出，下次启动时会进行实例恢复。<br>[postgresql@master ~]$ pg_ctl stop -D $PGDATA -m immediate<br>waiting for server to shut down.... done<br>server stopped<br>[postgresql@master ~]$<br><br><strong>使用immediate参数关闭数据库的日志：</strong><br>2025-09-06 19:41:40.311 CST [56278] LOG:&nbsp; received immediate shutdown request<br>2025-09-06 19:41:40.313 CST [56284] WARNING:&nbsp; terminating connection because of crash of another server process<br>2025-09-06
 19:41:40.313 CST [56284] DETAIL:&nbsp; The postmaster has commanded this 
server process to roll back the current transaction and exit, because 
another server process exited abnormally and possibly corrupted shared 
memory.<br>2025-09-06 19:41:40.313 CST [56284] HINT:&nbsp; In a moment you should be able to reconnect to the database and repeat your command.<br>2025-09-06 19:41:40.315 CST [56278] LOG:&nbsp; database system is shut down<br><br><strong>4、数据目录：</strong><br>[postgresql@master ~]$ echo $PGDATA<br>/usr/local/postgresql/data</p>
<p><br><strong>5、启动数据库：</strong><br>[postgresql@master ~]$ pg_ctl start -D $PGDATA<br>waiting for server to start....2025-09-06 19:40:40.221 CST [56258] LOG:&nbsp; redirecting log output to logging collector process<br>2025-09-06 19:40:40.221 CST [56258] HINT:&nbsp; Future log output will appear in directory "log".<br>&nbsp;done<br>server started<br>[postgresql@master ~]$</p>
</div>
